mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) indicates robust labor market conditions that directly support corporate earnings growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without regime dependence.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS increases by at least 100k in the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: When CPIAUCSL exceeds 299.0, it signals persistent inflation requiring aggressive monetary tightening, which compresses equity valuations and causes negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL exceeds 299.0.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous CPIAUCSL > 299.0 and UNRATE > 3.8% indicates stagflation, where high inflation and weak labor markets depress corporate margins, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 299.0 and UNRATE > 3.8%.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS > 4.0%), higher discount rates reduce equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Rising housing starts (HOUST) indicate strong consumer confidence and economic activity, directly supporting corporate revenue growth and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when HOUST increases by at least 5% in the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 100.0, it signals manufacturing contraction that reduces corporate output and profitability, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO < 100.0.

mechanism_narrative: Weak consumer spending (RSAFS < 650,000) combined with high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 299.0) indicates demand destruction, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when RSAFS < 650000 and CPIAUCSL > 299.0.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansions (UNRATE < 3.5%), tight labor markets support sustained corporate profit growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE < 3.5%.
